kodi.title: Kodi
kodi.intro: KMM updates Kodi after changes to movies via the JSON-RPC interface. To allow this, enable “Allow remote control via HTTP” in Kodi under Settings → Services → Control and enter port, user and password here. With the path mapping KMM finds the movies under Kodi’s own paths, e.g. smb://nas/movies/.

rename.title: Rename
rename.hint: Placeholders in '{ }', e.g. '{title}', '{year}', '{source}'; format after a colon: '{season:2}' (two digits), :first, :sort, :lower, :upper. Parts in [ ] are dropped if a placeholder in them is empty; / creates subfolders (only for the movie folder, relative to the source).
rename.triggersHint: The following triggers rename without a preview; only switch them on once your patterns have proven themselves.
rename.tvOnEdit: Rename TV shows after saving (TV show or episode)
rename.episodesOnScan: Rename new episodes during the scan

profile.title: 1. Ember profile
profile.hint: Choose the Ember folder on this computer. KMM only uploads the database MyVideos48.emm and the settings from it; the browser may ask whether all files should be uploaded. Ember is not changed, and after the import KMM deletes the uploaded files.

mapping.title: 2. Map paths
mapping.hint: Where are Ember’s movie and TV show sources as KMM sees them? If KMM runs on the same computer, the paths stay the same; under Docker enter e.g. /media/movies. The dry run changes nothing.
mapping.importTvShows: Import TV shows and episodes (episodes without a file are left out)
mapping.importSettings: Import settings (language, file extensions, excluded folders, proxy)
mapping.importKodiHosts: Import Kodi devices with credentials (paths via the mapping above)

report.title: Import result
report.episodeCounts: {created} new, {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped, {missing} without a file
report.missingFilesHint: Usually the directory is not reachable right now or the path mapping is wrong. The details from Ember have been imported anyway.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Downloads all KMM data as a file: sources, movies, TV shows, movie sets, filters, Kodi devices and settings. Media, NFOs and artwork are not included.
export.credentialsWarning: They are then stored in plain text in the file. Keep it safe and do not pass it on.

upload.title: Import
upload.hint: Choose a backup. You first see what it contains; nothing is changed yet.
upload.credentialsIncluded: included, they replace the existing ones
upload.credentialsMissing: not included, the existing ones stay

import.title: Paths and kind of import
import.mappingHint: Where are the sources as KMM sees them? If the path stays the same, leave it as it is. Under Docker it is the path in the container, for example /media/movies.
import.modeReplace: Replace: afterwards KMM has exactly the state of the file. Everything else is deleted.
import.modeMerge: Merge: existing data stays. If an entry matches, the file wins.
import.mergeQuestion: Restore the backup? Matching entries are overwritten with the details from the file, everything else stays.

report.title: Import result
report.unmapped: {count} without a matching mapping, they stayed unchanged
report.credentialsKept: The file contains none, the existing ones are kept.
